u1-a.en: Long ago, across the Red Sea from Arabia, there was a green land of high mountains called Abyssinia. Today we call it Ethiopia and Eritrea.
u1-a.t: Pada zaman dahulu, di seberang Laut Merah dari Tanah Arab, ada sebuah negeri hijau yang bergunung-ganang tinggi bernama Habsyah. Hari ini kita memanggilnya Ethiopia dan Eritrea.

u1-b.en: A girl called Barakah came from there, across the sea, to the town of Makkah. Barakah means blessing.
u1-b.t: Seorang gadis bernama Barakah datang dari sana, menyeberangi laut, ke kota Makkah. Barakah bermaksud keberkatan.

u1-sail.en: Help Barakah's boat cross the sea to Arabia.
u1-sail.t: Bantu perahu Barakah menyeberangi laut ke Tanah Arab.

u1-c.en: In Makkah she lived in the house of a young man called Abdullah. She was not free: she had to work for his family.
u1-c.t: Di Makkah dia tinggal di rumah seorang pemuda bernama Abdullah. Dia tidak bebas: dia terpaksa bekerja untuk keluarga Abdullah.

u1-d.en: Abdullah married a kind young woman called Amina. But soon Abdullah went away on a journey, and he died, far from home.
u1-d.t: Abdullah berkahwin dengan seorang wanita muda yang baik hati bernama Aminah. Tetapi tidak lama kemudian Abdullah pergi bermusafir, dan dia meninggal dunia, jauh dari rumah.

u1-q-no.en: Barakah came from Abyssinia, across the sea.
u1-q-no.t: Barakah datang dari Habsyah, di seberang laut.

u2-a.en: Then Amina had a baby boy. He was called Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.
u2-a.t: Kemudian Aminah melahirkan seorang bayi lelaki. Namanya Muhammad, sallallahu 'alaihi wasallam.

u2-b.en: Barakah loved the baby. She helped his mother look after him, by day and by night.
u2-b.t: Barakah menyayangi bayi itu. Dia membantu ibunya menjaganya, siang dan malam.

u2-rock.en: Rock the cradle gently. Press and hold, until he is fast asleep.
u2-rock.t: Hayunkan buaian itu perlahan-lahan. Tekan dan tahan, sehingga dia tidur lena.

u2-c.en: The baby's father, Abdullah, had left five camels, some sheep, and Barakah, who looked after the baby.
u2-c.t: Ayah bayi itu, Abdullah, telah meninggalkan lima ekor unta, beberapa ekor kambing, dan Barakah, yang menjaga bayi itu.

u2-camels.en: Count the five camels. Tap each one.
u2-camels.t: Kira kelima-lima ekor unta itu. Ketik setiap satu.

u2-q.en: Who helped Amina look after baby Muhammad?
u2-q.t: Siapakah yang membantu Aminah menjaga bayi Muhammad?

u2-q-no.en: Barakah helped his mother look after him, by day and by night.
u2-q-no.t: Barakah membantu ibunya menjaganya, siang dan malam.

u3-a.en: When Muhammad was six, his mother took him to visit her family in the town of Yathrib, which later was called Madina. Barakah went with them, on two camels.
u3-a.t: Apabila Muhammad berumur enam tahun, ibunya membawanya melawat keluarganya di kota Yathrib, yang kemudiannya dinamakan Madinah. Barakah pergi bersama mereka, menunggang dua ekor unta.

u3-b.en: They stayed a whole month with his mother's family, among the date palms.
u3-b.t: Mereka tinggal sebulan penuh bersama keluarga ibunya, di antara pohon-pohon kurma.

u3-c.en: Many years later, the Prophet remembered that month. He said that he learned to swim in a pond there, and flew pigeons with the boys.
u3-c.t: Bertahun-tahun kemudian, Nabi teringat akan bulan itu. Baginda berkata bahawa baginda belajar berenang di sebuah kolam di sana, dan menerbangkan burung merpati bersama budak-budak lelaki.

u3-pigeons.en: Count the pigeons! Tap each one.
u3-pigeons.t: Kira burung-burung merpati itu! Ketik setiap satu.

u3-pairs.en: Find the pairs! Things they saw in Madina.
u3-pairs.t: Cari pasangannya! Benda-benda yang mereka lihat di Madinah.

u4-a.en: On the way home, at a place called al-Abwa, his mother Amina fell ill.
u4-a.t: Dalam perjalanan pulang, di sebuah tempat bernama al-Abwa', ibunya Aminah jatuh sakit.

u4-b.en: And there, Amina died. Barakah stayed close to the little boy, and they were sad together.
u4-b.t: Dan di sana, Aminah meninggal dunia. Barakah sentiasa dekat dengan budak kecil itu, dan mereka bersedih bersama-sama.

u4-c.en: Then Barakah brought him home to Makkah, on the two camels.
u4-c.t: Kemudian Barakah membawanya pulang ke Makkah, menunggang dua ekor unta itu.

u4-home.en: Help Barakah bring him home to Makkah.
u4-home.t: Bantu Barakah membawanya pulang ke Makkah.

u4-d.en: Allah says to the Prophet in the Qur'an: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?
u4-d.t: Allah berfirman kepada Nabi di dalam al-Quran: Bukankah Dia mendapatimu seorang anak yatim, lalu Dia memberikan perlindungan?

u4-q.en: Who brought the little boy home to Makkah?
u4-q.t: Siapakah yang membawa budak kecil itu pulang ke Makkah?

u4-q-no.en: Barakah brought him home, on the two camels.
u4-q-no.t: Barakah membawanya pulang, menunggang dua ekor unta itu.

u5-a.en: In Makkah, his grandfather Abd al-Muttalib looked after him. He was a great old man of Makkah.
u5-a.t: Di Makkah, datuknya Abdul Muttalib menjaganya. Dia seorang tokoh tua yang dihormati di Makkah.

u5-b.en: He said to Barakah: O blessed one! Look after this son of mine, and never forget him.
u5-b.t: Dia berkata kepada Barakah: wahai yang diberkati! Jagalah anakku ini, dan jangan sekali-kali melupakannya.

u5-q.en: What did the grandfather call Barakah?
u5-q.t: Apakah panggilan datuk itu kepada Barakah?

u5-q-no.en: He called her: O blessed one. That is what Barakah means.
u5-q-no.t: Dia memanggilnya: wahai yang diberkati. Itulah maksud Barakah.

u5-c.en: But when the boy was eight, his grandfather died too. Barakah saw the boy crying as he walked behind his grandfather's funeral.
u5-c.t: Tetapi apabila budak itu berumur lapan tahun, datuknya juga meninggal dunia. Barakah melihat budak itu menangis sambil berjalan di belakang jenazah datuknya.

u5-d.en: Then his uncle Abu Talib took him into his home, and loved him like his own son.
u5-d.t: Kemudian bapa saudaranya Abu Talib membawanya tinggal di rumahnya, dan menyayanginya seperti anaknya sendiri.

u5-care.en: Who looked after him, one after the other? Put them in order.
u5-care.t: Siapakah yang menjaganya, seorang demi seorang? Susun mengikut urutan.

u5-care-c1.en: First, his mother Amina, with Barakah.

u5-care-no.en: Listen again, and put them in order.
u5-care-no.t: Dengar sekali lagi, dan susun mengikut urutan.

u6-a.en: The boy grew up into a good and honest young man. When he married Khadijah, he set Barakah free.
u6-a.t: Budak itu membesar menjadi seorang pemuda yang baik dan jujur. Apabila baginda berkahwin dengan Khadijah, baginda membebaskan Barakah.

u6-b.en: Barakah married a good man called Ubayd, and they had a son called Ayman. So people called her Umm Ayman: the mother of Ayman.
u6-b.t: Barakah berkahwin dengan seorang lelaki yang baik bernama Ubaid, dan mereka mendapat seorang anak lelaki bernama Aiman. Maka orang ramai memanggilnya Ummu Aiman: ibu kepada Aiman.

u6-c.en: The Prophet loved her very much. He used to call her: O mother!
u6-c.t: Nabi sangat menyayanginya. Baginda biasa memanggilnya: wahai ibu!

u6-d.en: It is told that he said: whoever would like to marry a woman of Paradise, let him marry Umm Ayman.
u6-d.t: Diceritakan bahawa baginda bersabda: sesiapa yang ingin berkahwin dengan seorang wanita ahli syurga, kahwinilah Ummu Aiman.

u6-e.en: Some years later, when her first marriage had ended, she married Zayd, a man the Prophet loved very much. They had a son too, called Usamah.
u6-e.t: Beberapa tahun kemudian, setelah perkahwinan pertamanya berakhir, dia berkahwin dengan Zaid, seorang lelaki yang sangat disayangi Nabi. Mereka juga mendapat seorang anak lelaki, bernama Usamah.

u6-names.en: What does each name mean? Match them.

u6-names-b3.en: Son of Zayd and Umm Ayman

u7-a.en: Many people in Makkah were cruel to the Muslims. So Allah let the Muslims move to Madina, far to the north.
u7-a.t: Ramai orang di Makkah berlaku kejam kepada orang Islam. Maka Allah mengizinkan orang Islam berhijrah ke Madinah, jauh di utara.

u7-b.en: Umm Ayman set out too, on the long, hot road to Madina.
u7-b.t: Ummu Aiman juga berangkat, melalui jalan yang panjang dan panas ke Madinah.

u7-c.en: She was fasting, and she grew very thirsty. And she had no water.
u7-c.t: Dia sedang berpuasa, dan dia menjadi sangat dahaga. Dan dia tidak mempunyai air.

u7-patient.en: Be patient, like Umm Ayman. Press and hold.
u7-patient.t: Bersabarlah, seperti Ummu Aiman. Tekan dan tahan.

u7-d.en: It is told that a bucket of cool water came down from the sky. She drank, and after that she was never thirsty again, even when she fasted on a hot day.
u7-d.t: Diceritakan bahawa sebuah timba berisi air sejuk turun dari langit. Dia minum, dan selepas itu dia tidak pernah dahaga lagi, walaupun ketika berpuasa pada hari yang panas.

u7-drops.en: Catch the cool drops of water!
u7-drops.t: Tangkap titisan-titisan air yang sejuk itu!

u7-e.en: At last she reached Madina, with its green date palms and its kind people.
u7-e.t: Akhirnya dia tiba di Madinah, dengan pohon-pohon kurmanya yang hijau dan penduduknya yang baik hati.

u8-a.en: Umm Ayman was brave and kind. When the Muslims had to defend Madina, at the mountain of Uhud, she went too.
u8-a.t: Ummu Aiman berani dan baik hati. Apabila orang Islam terpaksa mempertahankan Madinah, di gunung Uhud, dia juga pergi.

u8-b.en: She carried water to the thirsty, and she cared for the people who were hurt.
u8-b.t: Dia membawa air kepada mereka yang dahaga, dan dia merawat orang-orang yang cedera.

u8-cups.en: Give everyone water. Tap each cup.
u8-cups.t: Berilah air kepada semua orang. Ketik setiap cawan.

u8-c.en: Umm Ayman went with the Muslims to Khaybar too, to help.
u8-c.t: Ummu Aiman juga pergi bersama orang Islam ke Khaibar, untuk membantu.

u8-q.en: What did Umm Ayman bring to the people who were hurt?
u8-q.t: Apakah yang Ummu Aiman bawa kepada orang-orang yang cedera?

u8-q-no.en: She brought them water, and she cared for them.
u8-q-no.t: Dia membawa air kepada mereka, dan dia merawat mereka.

u9-a.en: In Madina, the Prophet gave Umm Ayman some date palms of her own.
u9-a.t: Di Madinah, Nabi memberikan Ummu Aiman beberapa pohon kurma miliknya sendiri.

u9-b.en: Later the palms had to go back to the family who had lent them. A boy called Anas came to ask for them.
u9-b.t: Kemudian pohon-pohon itu perlu dipulangkan kepada keluarga yang telah meminjamkannya. Seorang budak lelaki bernama Anas datang untuk memintanya.

u9-c.en: But Umm Ayman said: No! The Prophet gave them to me! So the Prophet offered her other trees instead. She still said no!
u9-c.t: Tetapi Ummu Aiman berkata: Tidak! Nabi telah memberikannya kepadaku! Maka Nabi menawarkan pokok-pokok lain kepadanya sebagai gantinya. Dia tetap berkata tidak!

u9-d.en: He kept offering her more, until she had about ten times as many! Then she was happy.
u9-d.t: Baginda terus menawarkan lebih banyak lagi, sehingga dia mendapat kira-kira sepuluh kali ganda! Barulah dia gembira.

u9-palms.en: Count her new palm trees! Tap all ten.
u9-palms.t: Kira pohon-pohon kurmanya yang baharu! Ketik kesemua sepuluh.

u9-e.en: Once Umm Ayman asked the Prophet for a camel to ride. He smiled and said: I will give you the baby of a camel! She said: but a baby camel cannot carry me!
u9-e.t: Pada suatu ketika Ummu Aiman meminta seekor unta daripada Nabi untuk ditunggang. Baginda tersenyum dan bersabda: aku akan memberimu anak unta! Dia berkata: tetapi anak unta tidak boleh membawaku!

u9-q.en: He said he would give her the baby of a camel. What did he mean?
u9-q.t: Baginda berkata baginda akan memberinya anak unta. Apakah maksud baginda?

u9-q-no.en: He was joking! Every camel, even a big one, is the baby of a mother camel.
u9-q-no.t: Baginda bergurau! Setiap unta, walaupun yang besar, ialah anak kepada ibu unta.

u10-a.en: When the Prophet's daughter Fatimah married Ali, Umm Ayman helped to get everything ready.
u10-a.t: Apabila puteri Nabi, Fatimah, berkahwin dengan Ali, Ummu Aiman membantu menyiapkan segala-galanya.

u10-b.en: Umm Ayman packed a bed made of palm leaves, a soft leather pillow stuffed with palm fibre, and a waterskin. And she spread soft sand on the floor.
u10-b.t: Ummu Aiman menyediakan sebuah katil daripada pelepah kurma, sebiji bantal kulit yang lembut diisi dengan sabut kurma, dan sebuah bekas air daripada kulit. Dan dia menaburkan pasir yang lembut di atas lantai.

u10-pack.en: What was in Fatimah's simple new home? Sort them.
u10-pack.t: Apakah yang ada di dalam rumah baharu Fatimah yang sederhana? Asingkan.

u10-pack-it5.t: Pasir yang lembut di atas lantai

u10-pack-no.en: Think again. Her home was very simple.
u10-pack-no.t: Fikir sekali lagi. Rumahnya sangat sederhana.

u10-c.en: Fatimah and Ali's home was small and simple, but it was full of love.
u10-c.t: Rumah Fatimah dan Ali kecil dan sederhana, tetapi penuh dengan kasih sayang.

u10-bricks.en: Help make their little home strong. Tap to place every brick.
u10-bricks.t: Bantu menguatkan rumah kecil mereka. Ketik untuk meletakkan setiap bata.

u11-a.en: The Prophet often went to visit Umm Ayman, to see how she was.
u11-a.t: Nabi sering pergi menziarahi Ummu Aiman, untuk bertanya khabarnya.

u11-b.en: Once she gave him a drink, and he did not take it. So she told him off, just like a mother!
u11-b.t: Pada suatu ketika dia memberi baginda minuman, dan baginda tidak mengambilnya. Maka dia menegur baginda, sama seperti seorang ibu!

u11-c.en: Then one day, the Prophet died. Everyone in Madina was very, very sad.
u11-c.t: Kemudian pada suatu hari, Nabi wafat. Semua orang di Madinah sangat-sangat sedih.

u11-g.en: Allah says in the Qur'an: Muhammad is only a messenger, before whom many messengers have been and gone.
u11-g.t: Allah berfirman di dalam al-Quran: Muhammad hanyalah seorang rasul, yang sebelumnya telah berlalu beberapa orang rasul.

u11-d.en: Abu Bakr said to Umar: let us go and visit Umm Ayman, as the Prophet used to visit her.
u11-d.t: Abu Bakar berkata kepada Umar: marilah kita pergi menziarahi Ummu Aiman, sebagaimana Nabi biasa menziarahinya.

u11-e.en: When they came, she wept. She said: I know he is with Allah, and that is better for him. I am crying because the news from heaven has stopped coming.
u11-e.t: Apabila mereka tiba, dia menangis. Dia berkata: aku tahu baginda bersama Allah, dan itu lebih baik bagi baginda. Aku menangis kerana berita dari langit telah berhenti datang.

u11-f.en: And Abu Bakr and Umar cried with her.
u11-f.t: Dan Abu Bakar dan Umar menangis bersamanya.

u11-q-no.en: She cried because the revelation, the news from heaven, had stopped coming.
u11-q-no.t: Dia menangis kerana wahyu, berita dari langit, telah berhenti datang.

u11-story.en: Tell Umm Ayman's whole story. Tap in order.
u11-story.t: Ceritakan seluruh kisah Ummu Aiman. Ketik mengikut urutan.

u11-story-c1.en: First, Barakah came from Abyssinia, across the sea.
u11-story-c1.t: Pertama, Barakah datang dari Habsyah, menyeberangi laut.

u11-story-c2.en: She looked after the baby, with his mother.
u11-story-c2.t: Dia menjaga bayi itu, bersama ibunya.

u11-story-c3.en: She brought the little boy home to Makkah on two camels.
u11-story-c3.t: Dia membawa budak kecil itu pulang ke Makkah dengan dua ekor unta.

u11-story-c4.en: He set her free, and she had a family.

u11-story-c5.en: She carried water to the hurt.
u11-story-c5.t: Dia membawa air kepada mereka yang cedera.

u11-story-c6.en: And he gave her ten times the palm trees.
u11-story-c6.t: Dan baginda memberinya pohon kurma sepuluh kali ganda.

u11-story-no.en: Listen again, and tell it in order.
u11-story-no.t: Dengar sekali lagi, dan ceritakan mengikut urutan.

end-a.en: This is the story of Umm Ayman, Barakah, the blessing. She looked after the Prophet from the day he was born, and he called her: O mother.
end-a.t: Inilah kisah Ummu Aiman, Barakah, sang keberkatan. Dia menjaga Nabi sejak hari baginda dilahirkan, dan baginda memanggilnya: wahai ibu.
